language.name: english
language.overview: Pubvana CMS is a modern open source PHP content management system. It ships with a clean, responsive default theme, flat-file friendly plugin and theme management, a widget-free block system, built in security hardening and a one click update path through the Pubvana release service.
language.features:
• Open source, MIT licensed PHP 8.2 CMS
  • Modern block based content regions via the extension registry
  • Trust Plugin: plugin, theme and release safety from the Pubvana trust service, shown as admin trust badges
  • One click updates through a signed releases feed with checksum verification
  • Built in cron scheduler for plugin tasks and maintenance
  • Stand alone JSON API and Banjo authentication
  • Flat-file and Composer plugin support over the adext extension registry
  • Hardenable production defaults, from CSP to session encryption keys
  • CLI tooling (Runway) for migrations, users, groups and maintenance
